verdict.rationale: The evidence implies native mobile crash support. Raygun accepts dSYM uploads (iOS symbolication) and ProGuard mapping files (Android deobfuscation), and its crash reports carry environment, version, and OS context with filtering by version and OS. However, there is no explicit iOS or Android SDK documentation, and NDK is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android SDK docs, NDK/native C++ crash capture, documented device-model context, independent hands-on corroboration of mobile crash capture.
